description: Creates a tracked link that tells upTake which visits, signups and payments came from where it is shared.

destination.description: Page to link to. A page of the maker's site gets a direct link; any other address a short /r/ link.

network.description: Where the link will be shared: x, linkedin, reddit, newsletter, producthunt, hackernews, youtube…

place.description: Optional detail of the place: a subreddit (r/SaaS), a newsletter issue (#12), a campaign name.

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

name: uptake_create_link
title: Create a tracked link
